verdict.rationale: The only robots.txt evidence is a probe of the Webfile/eSystems host (mycpa.cpa.state.tx.us), where robots.txt returned 404. No evidence shows a robots.txt on comptroller.texas.gov or data.texas.gov. Publishing robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so the axis applies, but nothing shows the product delivers it.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
